## What to build

`movecheck.mjs` — a plain Node ESM script, run as `node movecheck.mjs` from anywhere, plus a short
`README` beside it. It loads TypeScript through `createRequire` from
`<worktree>/admin/node_modules/typescript` (6.0.3; the link exists — check it and die loudly with the

### 1. Parse the OLD file
`git show origin/main:server/supabase/functions/collab/index.ts` (run git in the worktree). Parse it
with `ts.createSourceFile`. Collect, as named blocks:

- **17 mode branches.** Inside the `Deno.serve` arrow body, every top-level `IfStatement` whose
  condition text matches `^mode === '([a-z-]+)'( \|\| mode === '[a-z-]+')?$`. The block text runs
  from the start of the first statement to the end of the last statement of the `then` block.
  Key it by the first mode name. Expect exactly these 17 keys and **fail loudly on any other count**:
  create, join, list, mine, report, info, heartbeat, claim, update, start, wrap, reopen,
  upload-url, commit, download-url, leave, close.  (`claim` is the shared `claim || release` branch.)
- **2 gate slices,** by line range from the old text: `authorize` = old lines 294-352,
  `loadRoom` = old lines 635-686. Take those lines verbatim.
- **Every top-level declaration** (`FunctionDeclaration` and `VariableStatement`) by name, with its
  full source text. Expect exactly these 16 names and fail loudly otherwise:
  UUID_RE, MODES, LIST_LIMIT, MINE_LIMIT, UPLOAD_TTL_S, DOWNLOAD_TTL_S, R2_ENV, R2,
  storageBase, storageAuth, signUpload, signDownload, removePrefix, removeObject,
  SWEEP_LIMIT, sweepExpired.
  (`removePrefix`/`removeObject` are one destructuring `VariableStatement` — record it once under
  both names, or under a single key `removePrefix+removeObject`; say which in the README.)
  Also capture the free block at old 111-126 (the boot-log `{ … }` block) under key `bootlog`, and
  the `Deno.serve` parsing preamble at old 279-292 under key `serve-preamble`, and the sweep kick at
  old 354-364 under key `sweep-kick`. These are not declarations; slice them by line range.

### 2. Parse the NEW tree
Every `server/supabase/functions/collab/*.ts` **on the working tree** (not git). For each exported
function, take its body statements' text; drop a leading `const { … } = c;` and/or `const { … } = r;`
destructure; for `authorize` and `loadRoom` also drop the **final** `return { … };` statement.
Also index every top-level declaration by name and by file.

### 3. Map and diff
Build the section-4 mapping table **as data in the script**:

| old key | new file | new export |
| create | lobby.ts | createRoom |
| join | lobby.ts | joinRoom |
| list | browse.ts | listRooms |
| mine | browse.ts | mySessions |
| report | report.ts | reportRoom |
| info | info.ts | roomInfo |
| heartbeat | seats.ts | heartbeat |
| claim | seats.ts | claimOrRelease |
| update | lifecycle.ts | updateRoom |
| start | lifecycle.ts | startRoom |
| wrap | lifecycle.ts | wrapRoom |
| reopen | lifecycle.ts | reopenRoom |
| upload-url | push.ts | uploadUrl |
| commit | push.ts | commitUpload |
| download-url | pull.ts | downloadUrl |
| leave | lifecycle.ts | leaveRoom |
| close | lifecycle.ts | closeRoom |
| authorize | gate.ts | authorize |
| loadRoom | room.ts | loadRoom |

and for declarations: UUID_RE→gate.ts; MODES, serve-preamble, sweep-kick→index.ts;
LIST_LIMIT, MINE_LIMIT→browse.ts; UPLOAD_TTL_S, DOWNLOAD_TTL_S, R2_ENV, R2, bootlog, storageBase,
storageAuth, signUpload, signDownload, removePrefix/removeObject→bucket.ts;
SWEEP_LIMIT, sweepExpired→sweep.ts.

For every old key, resolve it to ONE of these outcomes and print a line for each:

- `MOVED   <key>` — the assigned file exists and holds it, and the normalized bodies are **identical**.
- `DIFF    <key>` — found in its assigned home but the text differs. Print the `diff -u` (unified,
  through a real `diff` child process or a JS unified-diff you write) and set a non-zero exit.
- `INLINE  <key>` — the assigned file does not have it yet, but the block is still present,
  byte-identical (after normalization), in `collab/index.ts` where it is today. **This is the
  expected state for anything a later pass moves** — it proves the untouched blocks are untouched.
- `INLINE-DIFF <key>` — still in `index.ts` but changed. Print the diff. Non-zero exit.
- `LOST    <key>` — not in its assigned home and not in `index.ts`. **Loud failure**, non-zero exit.

Normalization before diffing: strip trailing whitespace per line, drop leading/trailing blank lines,
and strip the block's **common leading indentation** (the minimum indent over non-blank lines).
Nothing else — no comment stripping, no whitespace collapsing inside a line. A pure move must survive
exactly this.

### 4. Symbol inventory (8a.5)
Separately, print a `SYMBOLS` section: every one of the 16 old top-level names must appear **exactly
once** as a top-level declaration across all `collab/*.ts` (index.ts included). More than once or
zero times is a failure. Imports do not count — only declarations. And `Deno.serve` must appear in
`index.ts` and in no other `collab/*.ts`. Non-zero exit on any violation.

### 5. Make it impossible to pass vacuously
This is the point of the whole exercise. The script must **fail loudly**, with a non-zero exit and an
obvious message, when:
- the old-file parse yields anything other than 17 branches / 16 declarations / both gate slices
  (i.e. a hard assertion on the expected key sets, not a "found N, moving on");
- any old key resolves to none of the outcomes above;
- an assigned new file exists but does not export the function the table names;
- a `collab/*.ts` file exists that the table knows nothing about.

Print a final `RESULT: clean (N moved, M inline)` or `RESULT: NOT CLEAN — <n> problems`, and
`process.exit(1)` on anything but clean. Exit status is what the later passes will trust.
